prospect.name: Nick
prospect.aka: Addressed as Nicholas by the rep
prospect.location: State College area, Pennsylvania, USA (Eastern time)
prospect.occupation: Desk-based office job, roughly 8am to 5.30pm, ten-minute commute; income $5,000 every two weeks
prospect.family_status: Brother getting engaged; no partner or children mentioned
prospect.training_background: Played lacrosse in college and sports in high school. Long CrossFit period training daily at 6am. Currently a stale gym routine plus weekly volleyball. Has followed Trevor for around nine months and done some of his free workouts.
prospect.medical: Three unresolved musculoskeletal issues. Right shoulder pain on overhead pressing. A lumbar injury five months ago while deadlifting — 'got super tight, locked up, had to go to the chiropractor for, like, six weeks, and, yeah, so, and that pain still happens a lot.' An undiagnosed right knee problem from skiing — 'I never got it officially confirmed, but it was like something in my, something behind the knee was, like, hyper-extended'. He also describes a general pattern of never rehabbing sports injuries properly.

signals: Explicitly measures himself against a former self: 'I'd probably say like a six... 10 would be like back if back in college' — described as 10% body fat, 50 pull-ups, 100 push-ups.

Carries visible regret about lost capability: 'I remember when I could do everything 100%, and now it's like, with the pain, you know, your body naturally will inhibit your movement, and that just drives me crazy.'
Lost ground to a specific hard season — a deadlift injury five months ago plus heavy travel and weddings breaking his routine.
Price was never an objection; only the timing of liquidity was.

goals.text: Clear the shoulder pain and the lower back stiffness so injuries stop limiting him
Play sports recreationally at full capacity again without worrying about re-injury
Get flexibility back, which he calls the biggest thing right now
Lock in a routine that survives work travel, like the CrossFit habit used to
Train without needing a gym so travel stops being an excuse
Reverse the effects of sitting at a desk all day
Find a way to strengthen the knee he has never been able to strengthen

pains.text: Lumbar injury five months ago requiring six weeks of chiropractic care, with pain that still recurs frequently
Right shoulder pain during overhead pressing
Undiagnosed right knee instability from a skiing hyperextension; limits sprinting and jumping
Years of training on top of injuries he never rehabbed and ignoring the pain
Bored of a gym routine he has done a thousand times and loses the desire once he gets there
Travel for work and weddings has broken his routine and he cannot restart it
Has joined gym after gym expecting the change of venue to fix motivation, and it never has
Body fat drifted from around 10% to a self-estimated 21-22%
Desk-bound all day and aware his mobility work does not offset it

objections.raw_quote: Then I would just have to sell some of my stocks. I don't keep that much in savings.
objections.rep_response: Asked what was in savings ($3,000) and when the next paycheck landed (one week), then proposed splitting into two payments of $3,000.

objections.raw_quote: Well, actually, could we do three two ones, three twos or no? Just because my rent is going to be on the next one.
objections.rep_response: Agreed immediately and restructured to three payments of $2,000, stated as interest-free, with an option to clear the balance early via a custom link.

objections.raw_quote: Is this a free coaching extension? I'm not missing anything in that contract, am I?
objections.rep_response: Did not walk through the terms. Said 'you get a copy of it, but it's very straightforward' and pivoted to a verbal continuation promise.

offer.payment_plan_terms: Three monthly payments of $2,000, stated twice as interest-free. First $2,000 taken on the call after an initial card decline. Rep offered to issue a custom link to clear the balance early and cancel the remaining automatic payments.
offer.guarantee_mentioned: Stated verbally in response to a direct question about the contract: 'if you put every bit of effort in that you can put in, then Trevor's also just going to keep on coaching if we don't get to the goals. Trevor's so certain of what he does that that's also really what he focuses on.' No written terms were reviewed on the call.

evidence: Payment was taken live. After an initial decline ('Apple declined it. Says my card was restricted') a second card went through and the rep confirmed receipt: 'Then it should come through on my end any second as well. Oh, yeah. I see it.'
Onboarding call with Trevor booked for the following Tuesday at 5.45pm and confirmed in the prospect's inbox: 'it's on Trevor Jones shared an onboarding call.'
Skool community access verified live — the rep had him click through the community, classroom and calendar tabs and confirmed he was in.
Onboarding form received and instructions given to complete it before Tuesday: 'Okay, I'll take care of this when I get home.'
Counter-evidence: the agreement email arrived but was not signed on the call, and when the prospect asked what was in the contract the rep did not go through it.
Counter-evidence: only the first $2,000 of $6,000 has been collected; the remaining two payments are scheduled.
outcome.next_step: Complete the onboarding form before Tuesday, sign the agreement, introduce himself in the Skool community, buy a kettlebell on Trevor's guidance after the onboarding call. Rep to check whether Trevor can move the call earlier to Monday.

notable.note: Cleanest close in the batch procedurally, and the highest clinical exposure in the batch. He disclosed three unresolved injuries including a lumbar injury five months ago that needed six weeks of chiropractic care and still hurts, plus an undiagnosed knee he says was never officially confirmed. Nobody asked whether a clinician had cleared him for loaded ballistic training, and the rep asserted the programme would strengthen those specific joints and that similar cases 'can 100% get better'. Also note: the rep answered a direct contract question with 'it's very straightforward' without reading it, and attached a verbal free-extension guarantee to it.

quality.notes: Heavy inversion throughout, including whole multi-sentence passages. The long physique self-assessment at 00:05:01 and the entire nutrition and intermittent-fasting exchange around 00:29:21-00:31:00 carry the wrong labels. The payment and onboarding sequence from 00:39:00 onward is badly interleaved. Role was determined from content. Note also that the calendar owner is transcribed as 'Trevor Jones' here while another call in this batch shows the Skool community owner as 'Trevor Shearn'; neither surname is recorded as established.
